Suicide attack kills 15 in Pakistan; India rejects flood claims

A suicide bombing in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province killed at least 15 people, including 12 soldiers, according to the army. The attack targeted a security checkpost near the Afghan border. The Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) claimed responsibility for the blast. Separately, India's Ministry of External Affairs dismissed Pakistan's allegations regarding floods as 'baseless' and false.
